sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sumit Prakash, Advocate For the Opp. Party : Mr. Suraj Deo Munda, A.P.P.
-----
4/ 02.09.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jamua P.S. Case No. 05 of 2025, arising out of Complaint Case No. 1579 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 354-B, 376, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Smt. Sushila Hansda, learned Judicial Magistrate,
1st Class, Giridih.
3. On 23.05.2024, the petitioner is alleged to have entered into the house of the informant and raped her.
4. It was submitted that initially a complaint case was filed on 18.06.2024 and thereafter, police case was registered.
5. There appears to be a delay of about one month in lodging the complaint case.
6. In view of the submission made above, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Smt. Sushila Hansda, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class, Giridih, or her successor,
Vishal Suman vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
